endpoints.description: List firewall/security devices managed by Tufin SecureTrack. Use count and start to page. Read-only.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max devices to return per page

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: pagination offset (0-based)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: filter by device name substring

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: filter by vendor (e.g. Cisco, PaloAltoNetworks, CheckPoint)

endpoints.description: Get a single SecureTrack device by its id. Requires a deviceId — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one from a result row. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List the security rules (policy) of a device. Requires a deviceId — call tufin_list_devices first. Use count and start to page. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max rules to return per page

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: pagination offset (0-based)

endpoints.description: List the installed policy packages of a device. Requires a deviceId — call tufin_list_devices first. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List the network interfaces of a device. Requires a deviceId — call tufin_list_devices first. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one

endpoints.description: Search rules within a single device by free-text/field query. Requires a deviceId — call tufin_list_devices first. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain one

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: SecureTrack rule search expression, e.g. 'source:10.0.0.0/8 AND action:accept'

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max rules to return

endpoints.description: Search rules across all devices by free-text/field query. Read-only.

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: SecureTrack rule search expression across all devices

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max rules to return

endpoints.description: Get the documentation (owner, ticket, comment, expiration) for a specific rule. Requires a deviceId and ruleId — call tufin_get_device_rules first to obtain both. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: the device id — call tufin_get_device_rules first

parameters.name: ruleId
parameters.description: the rule id — call tufin_get_device_rules first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List all SecureTrack security zones. Read-only.
List the subnet/host entries of a security zone. Requires a zoneId — call tufin_list_zones first to obtain one. Read-only.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: the zone id — call tufin_list_zones first to obtain one

endpoints.description: Search network objects (hosts, subnets, groups) by name or IP. Optionally restrict to a device — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain a device_id. Read-only.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: object name or IP filter expression

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: restrict search to a device — call tufin_list_devices to obtain an id

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max objects to return

endpoints.description: Policy analysis: find rules matching a source/destination/service traffic tuple. Optionally restrict to a device — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain a device_id. Read-only.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: source IP or subnet

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: destination IP or subnet

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: service/port, e.g. tcp/443

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: restrict to a device — call tufin_list_devices to obtain an id

endpoints.description: List Unified Security Policy (USP) matrices. Read-only.
Get a single Unified Security Policy by id. Requires a policyId — call tufin_list_security_policies first to obtain one. Read-only.

parameters.name: policyId
parameters.description: the security policy id — call tufin_list_security_policies first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List exceptions of a Unified Security Policy. Requires a policyId — call tufin_list_security_policies first to obtain one. Read-only.

parameters.name: policyId
parameters.description: the security policy id — call tufin_list_security_policies first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List topology interfaces for a management device. Requires mgmtId — call tufin_list_devices to obtain a device id. Read-only.

parameters.name: mgmtId
parameters.description: management device id — call tufin_list_devices to obtain one

endpoints.description: List rule cleanup issues (shadowed, unused, permissive rules). Optionally restrict to a device — call tufin_list_devices first to obtain a device_id. Read-only.

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: restrict to a device — call tufin_list_devices to obtain an id

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: max issues to return
